description: This file defines the 'ConsoleMessage' class, which models console messages captured within the browser context or Electron application in the Playwright testing framework. It handles properties like message type, text, arguments, location, and associated page or worker.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message originating from the browser context or Electron application, with methods to access message details like type, text, arguments, location, and associated page or worker.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Returns the Worker associated with this console message, if any.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page associated with this console message, if any.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the console message (e.g., log, warning, error).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the text content of the console message.

methods.name: args
methods.description: Returns an array of JSHandle objects representing the arguments of the console message.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Returns the location information (such as URL and line number) associated with the console message.

methods.name: _inspect
methods.description: Private method used for custom inspection of the console message.
